headline: Board to vote on Vessel Services Request and on accepting North Coast Seafoods Corp as a new buyer at the Portland Fish Exchange.
summary: The board will review financial and facilities updates, vote on a Vessel Services Request, and vote on a recommendation to accept North Coast Seafoods Corp as a new buyer at the Portland Fish Exchange. Staff will also give verbal updates on berthing revenue and waterfront activities.
items: Financial Update from Kaela Gonzalez, Program Coordinator
Facilities Update from Phil DiPierro, Project Manager
Review and vote on Vessel Services Request
Portland Fish Exchange Subcommittee Update from Matt Moretti
Review and vote on recommendation to accept North Coast Seafoods Corp as a new buyer at the Exchange
Verbal Staff Update from Heather Moretti, Waterfront Coordinator
Other items not on the agenda
